preconditions.description: The number of tournaments is between 1 and 50000, inclusive.
The number of kinds of sport is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The power of each sportsman in each kind of sport is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: All powers for any kind of sport are distinct
preconditions.description: For any kind of sport, all powers are unique.

postconditions.expression: The output for each tournament is the number of possible winners.
postconditions.description: For each of the n tournaments, the output is the number of sportsmen who can potentially be the winner based on their powers across all k kinds of sport.
